parts.t: Welcome to Canopy by StreetSide Developments! This 4 bed, 3.5 bath townhome shines with a bright open layout, a chef-inspired kitchen with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, gas range, and island made for entertaining. Enjoy your private patio with BBQ hookup, spacious bedrooms, and a dreamy primary suite with walk-in closet and double sinks. The lower level offers a flexible 4th bedroom with ensuite—ideal for guests or a home office. Trails, parks, schools, and Highway 1 are just minutes away!
